parameters.query:
UPDATE competitions
SET
    "title" = COALESCE(NULLIF("title", ''), NULLIF('{{$json.title}}', '')),

    "organizer" = COALESCE(
        "organizer",
        NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json.organizer || null) }}', 'null')::jsonb
    ),

    "categories" = COALESCE(
        NULLIF("categories", ''),
        NULLIF('{{$json.categories}}', '')
    ),

    "views" = COALESCE(
        "views",
        {{$json.views || 'NULL'}}
    ),

    "level" = COALESCE(
        "level",
        NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json.level || null) }}', 'null')::jsonb
    ),

    "startDate" = COALESCE(
        "startDate",
        NULLIF('{{$json.startDate}}', '')::date
    ),

    "endDate" = COALESCE(
        "endDate",
        NULLIF('{{$json.endDate}}', '')::date
    ),

    "format" = COALESCE(
        NULLIF("format", ''),
        NULLIF('{{$json.format}}', '')
    ),

    "participationType" = COALESCE(
        NULLIF("participationType", ''),
        NULLIF('{{$json.participationType}}', '')
    ),

    "pricing" = COALESCE(
        "pricing",
        NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json.pricing || null) }}', 'null')::jsonb
    ),

    "location" = COALESCE(
        NULLIF("location", ''),
        NULLIF('{{$json.location}}', '')
    ),

    "whatsappChannel" = COALESCE(
        "whatsappChannel",
        {{$json.whatsappChannel ?? 'NULL'}}
    ),

    "url" = COALESCE(
        NULLIF("url", ''),
        NULLIF('{{$json.url}}', '')
    ),

    "updatedAt" = NOW()

WHERE "id" = '{{$json.id}}'::uuid;
